analysis: This PR changes only documentation: a new changelog.d entry and a 7-line addition at docs/architecture/inference.md head lines 85-91. No source code changes are in the supplied batch. The text says EnginePerformanceMeasurements.Rate anchors age/expiry to the newest observation in each aggregate, current-posture or workload-bucket series, so a delayed older receipt cannot move freshness backward or create a false evidence gap. Rate averaging and sample counts still follow receipt consumption order, and a heartbeat snapshot alone never renews evidence. Relevant threat areas: the performance evidence that feeds capacity heartbeats and first-content deadline admission. These are related to the TB-002 provider/coordinator contract and the deadline-qualification discussion, but they map to no specific retained threat ID. The prefix-cache threat T-041 is unaffected. No finding is raised: the supplied evidence has no code showing the freshness implementation, so I cannot verify that it matches the documentation. The next pass should check the actual EnginePerformanceMeasurements.Rate change, if it is in another batch, for two things. First, delayed receipts must not extend qualified freshness across a posture-epoch change, since the existing text says a power or thermal transition clears qualified freshness. Second, calibration or startupWarmup receipts must remain excluded from the newest-observation anchor. This is a doc and changelog review only, with no claim about the code.
